description: Defines the IsolationInfo class used for managing network request context information, including origins, request types, and cookie policies within the Chromium network stack.

classes.name: IsolationInfo
classes.description: Represents network request context information, including origins, request type, and cookie policies, with methods for creation, serialization, and validation.

methods.name: CreateForInternalRequest
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo for internal requests with the specified top frame origin.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an IsolationInfo from a string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo with specified parameters, ensuring internal consistency.

methods.name: CreateIfConsistent
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo if parameters are consistent, otherwise returns nullopt.

methods.name: CreateForRedirect
methods.description: Creates a new IsolationInfo for a redirect to a new origin.

methods.name: ToDoUseTopFrameOriginAsWell
methods.description: Temporary method to handle cases where top frame origin is not used correctly.
